part_3_defect_requiring_revision.title: the recovered bundle has no surviving release-consumption path after epoch-7 lands
evidence_chain: validator _validate_release_once (6605, invoked at 6765) validates a published bundle with published_release_revalidation=True
that flag routes (2792) to producer _validate_published_validator_bundle (8934), which borrows _official_validator_replay_scope (8983) with require_current checks (9019, 9105, 9022)

the bundle validation tail unconditionally invokes _active_replay_selected_pipeline (6378), reaching producer replay_selected_pipeline whose validate_implementation_blob call at 10263 uses the default require_current=True (definition 3746-3752: current-byte equality)
after epoch-7 lands, the worktree carries epoch-7 bytes, so every current-byte check against the selected epoch-6 implementation fails
a pinned historical checkout cannot evade this: the release authorization is created only after recovery, so no pre-epoch-7 commit can contain it
part_3_defect_requiring_revision.classification: the one-wall-later class that consumed epochs 3 and 4; the 2026-08-20 design f9e9774c section 7.3.1 existed precisely for this wall and this proposal dropped it while marking the release rows unchanged in section 8.2
required_revision_alternatives: extend the section 8.2 disposition and section 12 tests to the published-release revalidation path within the same four files: historical anchor for selected identity, live anchor for executing code, and a registered post-epoch-7 release-revalidation positive

or disclose the release wall explicitly as a deferred follow-up epoch with its own owner acknowledgment, stating that epoch-7 recovery publishes a bundle that cannot be released until that epoch lands
part_3_defect_requiring_revision.reviewer_preference: the first alternative: one surgery, no deferred wall, no additional epoch
